'''Emita Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[Emita/Legends|Emita]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. It was the smallest spaceport on the planet and primarily processed commercial shipping. It was the only spaceport on the continent of [[Ananta]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
